what_it_does: Power supplies (DC-DC converters) that feed modern AI chips need to deliver steady current across many parallel conversion phases—imagine a power strip with dozens of outlets that must share load evenly. This paper describes HOOP, a hybrid converter design that uses a ring topology to automatically balance current between parallel converter units without requiring complex digital control circuits. The novelty lies in extending prior charge-balancing tricks (used in simpler single-phase converters) to work across multiple hybrid converter modules in parallel, making the power distribution simpler and more scalable for chips with hundreds of power phases.
